matches.detail: Veto: Aurora removed Ancient, FURIA removed Anubis, Aurora picked Dust2, FURIA picked Inferno, Aurora removed Cache, FURIA removed Mirage, Nuke left over. KSCERATO rated 1.67.

Veto: BETBOOM removed Inferno, Falcons removed Cache, BETBOOM picked Anubis, Falcons picked Dust2, BETBOOM removed Ancient, Falcons removed Nuke, Mirage left over. BETBOOM lost the first map 5-13, then won Dust2 16-14 and Mirage 13-7.

day_five_guidance.card: FURIA face BETBOOM in the best-of-five grand final at 15:00 UTC; Aurora meet Falcons in the third-place decider at 11:30 UTC. Thunderpick prices both, and the de-vig gives FURIA 68.2% and Falcons 65.5%. Neither match is a Hotspawn board row.
day_five_guidance.headline: Day five: FURIA–BETBOOM for the title, Aurora–Falcons for third
day_five_guidance.summary: The semi-finals resolved both fixtures. FURIA beat Aurora 2-0 and BETBOOM beat Falcons 2-1, so the grand final is FURIA–BETBOOM and the third-place decider is Aurora–Falcons. Thunderpick, the event sponsor, is the only operator found with a two-way price on either match; the published probabilities are its de-margined Match Winner lines. Neither fixture appears in the Hotspawn pick'em board, so both are research picks that cannot be submitted.

points.detail: Dust2 13-8 and Inferno 13-10 on 17 October; KSCERATO rated 1.67. Veto ended with Nuke unused.
Falcons won Anubis 13-5, then BETBOOM won Dust2 16-14 and Mirage 13-7. Falcons had been about a 72.5% favourite in the last retained exchange quote.

points.claim: The grand final is FURIA–BETBOOM and the third-place decider is Aurora–Falcons.
points.detail: Both day-5 HLTV pages now name the teams; the fixtures start at 11:30 and 15:00 UTC on 18 October.

points.claim: No October roster change explains an Aurora upset.
points.detail: Aurora's five is the July rebuild: kyxsan joined on 8 July 2026, Jimpphat and coach ash the same day. The team page lists the same five as Valve's 5 October roster file.

points.claim: FURIA have beaten BETBOOM 2-0 in both recent meetings.
points.detail: At this event on 14 October and at ESL Pro League Season 24 about two weeks earlier. The final is a best-of-five.

not_listed.why: Falcons are ranked #5 and Aurora #6, and Falcons lead the head-to-head 1-0 in the last 30 days. Aurora are the measured contrarian rather than the pick: HLTV gives them the better recent form ranking, and they had about three more hours of recovery after playing two maps rather than three. That is a schedule fact, not a measured fatigue effect, and it does not flip a 65.5% line.
